title: The Borrowed Pencil Worn Down
youtube_title: The Borrowed Pencil Worn Down | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Hiding a dent does not make the dent untrue.
summary: At a kitchen table with jam, butter, and a shared pencil tin, Greta is tangled up with a borrowed pencil worn shorter than when it left and almost hides it. Greta tells Ms. Okonkwo the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
